title: OA-WAM address routing
question: Why split addr and cnt, and why restrict only the slot key?
summary: Stable slot keys choose an object while full-state values and residuals carry its changing content; a per-layer reset preserves that division across the trunk.

states.title: Address coordinates restored after a block

scenarios.title: Select by stable identity, read current content
assumptions: Upstream perception extracted the relevant object slot.
The address was initialized without ambiguity.

steps.title: Separate identity and content
steps.explanation: Construct each slot with a dedicated address subvector and a separate content subvector.

steps.title: Use different lifecycles
steps.explanation: Keep addr fixed through the episode and recompute cnt from the current observation every frame.

steps.title: Form the query from full context
steps.explanation: Project Q from the full hidden state so the querying position can remain context-dependent.

steps.title: Expose stable identity through K
steps.explanation: At slot positions, zero coordinates after the address slice before the key projection.
steps.condition: The token is a slot position.

steps.title: Carry current content through V
steps.explanation: Project V from the full hidden state, retaining time-varying content for the information read from a selected slot.

steps.title: Select and retrieve
steps.explanation: Use Q and address-restricted K to form attention weights, then apply those weights to full-state V.

steps.title: Restore the address after every block
steps.explanation: After residual and feed-forward updates, restore only the first 32 slot coordinates from the cached address and keep the other 4064 coordinates updated.
stateChanges: address coordinates become state.addr-restored; non-address coordinates retain the block update

steps.title: Read the routed result at ACT_Q
steps.explanation: The action head consumes the final ACT_Q hidden state, which can depend on content retrieved through values and residual updates.

steps.title: Test the mask and reset switches
steps.explanation: Compare no OA, reset only, and full mask-plus-reset variants on the same LP-camera metric.

steps.title: Intervene on the address
steps.explanation: Swap the target address while holding other inputs fixed and measure whether the end-effector trajectory follows the swapped target.

steps.title: Preserve the perception boundary
steps.explanation: Treat address routing as conditional on correct slot extraction and unambiguous address initialization.

branches.condition: The token is not a slot position.
branches.description: Use the unmodified base attention path.

unresolved: The selected evidence does not establish real-robot robustness.
